requirements_summary: Workload: interactive code assistant integrated into VS Code + webiframe; session affinity, low tail latency for completions.
Latency target: median <120ms for short completions (<256 tokens), p95 <500ms when KV cache hits.
Throughput target: typical 10-30 rps per instance, but bursts up to 150 rps during peak developer edit sessions.
Context window: need support for 50k token windows; willing to use prefix/KV caching or chunked retrieval; care about semantic coherence for multi-file refactors.
Rate limits: need higher burst limits or adjustable per-account policy; want clear guidance on retry/backoff and exponential smoothing for client SDK.
SDKs: asks for first-class JS/TS browser-friendly SDK with websocket streaming + example showing incremental tokens and cancelation hooks.
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget but willing to pay for predictable performance; interested in Optimize suggestions (batching + cache) to reduce per-token cost.
Security: SSO (SAML) for team, audit logs for actions, ability to set retention of prompts (14/30/90d) — not strict residency needs at this stage.
